home.title: A place to remember
home.subtitle: Keep a life recorded, and let family and friends find it.

auth.signInSubtitle: We will email you a six digit code.
auth.codeSubtitle: We sent a six digit code to {email}.

memorial.relationshipHelp: A memorial can be created by a spouse, parent, child or sibling.
memorial.truthDeclaration: I confirm this information is true and I accept responsibility for managing this memorial.
memorial.aliasesLabel: Other names they were known by
memorial.duplicateWarning: A similar memorial already exists. Please look at it before creating a new one.

privacy.title: Who can see this memorial
privacy.publicHelp: Anyone can find and visit this memorial.
privacy.unlistedHelp: Not listed in search. Anyone holding the link can visit.
privacy.inviteOnlyHelp: Only people you invite can sign in and visit.
privacy.searchEngineLabel: Allow search engines to list this memorial
privacy.confirmPublicBody: The name, life story and photos will be visible to anyone, and search engines may list the page. You can change this later, but a search engine may keep an older copy for some time.
privacy.confirmPublicAcknowledge: I understand and want this memorial to be public.

religion.title: Faith and cultural tradition
religion.help: This only shapes what we suggest. Nothing is turned on until you choose it.

ritual.title: Ways visitors may remember them
ritual.help: Choose each one you want to offer. Nothing is offered unless you turn it on.
ritual.needsConfirmation: This varies between communities. Please confirm it suits your family.
ritual.notRecommended: This is not usually offered in this tradition.

moderation.pendingBody: Thank you. The family will see this before it appears.
moderation.reportTitle: Report a problem with this memorial

errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some of the information provided could not be accepted.
errors.MEMORIAL_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.INVITATION_REQUIRED: An invitation from the family is required to view this memorial.
errors.RELATIONSHIP_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Only a spouse, parent, child or sibling can create a memorial.
errors.PUBLIC_EXPOSURE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Please confirm that this memorial may be seen publicly before continuing.
errors.DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE_FOUND: A similar memorial already exists. Please review it before creating a new one.
errors.RITUAL_NOT_ENABLED: The family has not enabled this way of remembering.
